scores.tell: Binocular head is cropped very large and fills the card top to bottom with a detailed city and railing scene competing for focus; real cards show a smaller hero with a simple backdrop.
The pier is a wide scene. The hero is spread across the whole card, and the lifebuoy, posts and sea all compete. Real cards usually have a single compact hero with margin around it.
none. The planet is tilted and centered with comfortable margin on a simple striped backdrop, like the towel and whistle cards.
The ball fills almost the full width and nearly touches the edges, with little margin. Cropped tight, but it is still a single clear hero.
none. The calculator is tilted and centered, fills the card well, and sits on a simple patterned background like the real cards.
The helmet is centered and sized well. The shelf split in the background adds a slight scene feel.
The rope is centered and readable. The figure-8 shape is a little tall and empty in the middle, and the wavy background is busy.
The boot is a tall, narrow shape, left-weighted and upright. It leaves empty space on the right, and the real boot is a more diagonal, fuller shape.
none. The hat is tilted and centered with good margin on a simple ringed backdrop that matches the real cards.
The club is cropped by the right edge, and the ball sits low-center. The grass and hills compete for focus, which makes it a scene rather than a clean hero.
